provides: The reaction layer: declarative 'when event X happens, do Y' subscriptions over the fleet's comm Actions, delivered as HMAC-signed retried webhooks, notifications, realtime frames or allowlisted app-layer callables, with a per-delivery evidence row, a retry ladder, a dead letter and replay.

curated.summary: On by default: every event an installed package declares in schemas/emits/ can be subscribed to, so what customers may react to follows what is installed. Off: only WATCH_EVENTS are wired.

deferred (default): a matching event writes delivery rows and a drain performs the network calls. inline: deliver right after commit in the emitting process — a dev/monolith convenience that webhooks.W004 warns about.

Ships closed: webhook targets must be https and resolve to a public address (SSRF guard). True opens http:// and private/loopback targets for a dev box or an in-cluster receiver; webhooks.W003 reports it while it is on.
curated.business_label: Deliver to private or plain-http endpoints

extension_points.name: DELIVERY_TYPES
extension_points.summary: Delivery-type registry ({name: spec | None}, merged over the webhook/notification/ws/custom built-ins; register_delivery_type() at runtime). None removes a type — how a host closes custom. A spec replaces, no deep merge.

extension_points.name: TRANSPORT
extension_points.summary: The outbound HTTP transport (post + classify): egress proxy, mTLS or a test double. The default carries the SSRF guard. Never read from the environment.

extension_points.name: SIGNER
extension_points.summary: Signature scheme (sign/verify) — speak another provider's signature dialect. Never read from the environment.

extension_points.name: MATCHER
extension_points.summary: The subscription filter language: callable(payload, predicate) -> bool. Never read from the environment.

extension_points.name: EXTRA_CATALOG_PATHS
extension_points.summary: Package roots whose schemas/emits/ also feed the event catalog — lets a non-app library contribute subscribable events.

extension_points.name: STAPEL_SWAP["WEBHOOKS_SUBSCRIPTION_PRESENTER"] / ["WEBHOOKS_DELIVERY_PRESENTER"]
extension_points.summary: Reshape either response body with a Presenter subclass.

surface.name: build_catalog
surface.intent: Scan every source (installed packages' schemas/emits/, EXTRA_CATALOG_PATHS, WATCH_EVENTS) into {event: entry}, uncached — for a check or a command that must see the current state.

surface.name: catalog_event_names
surface.intent: The sorted subscribable event names — what a subscription UI offers.

surface.name: event_catalog
surface.intent: Every subscribable event of this deployment, keyed by name (cached) — the vocabulary the create endpoint and webhooks.event_catalog answer from.

surface.name: event_schema
surface.intent: The declared JSON schema of an event, if the catalog carries one — what a filter builder reads to offer fields.

surface.name: is_known_event
surface.intent: Whether an event name is declared by some installed package — the check a subscription create runs before accepting a topic.

surface.name: reset_catalog
surface.intent: Drop the cached catalog after INSTALLED_APPS changes, and between tests.

surface.name: delivery_handler
surface.intent: Import and return a delivery type's handler callable; the one place a spec's dotted path becomes code.

surface.name: get_delivery_types
surface.intent: The effective delivery-type registry (built-ins <- settings <- runtime, None removing); read this instead of the setting so removals and runtime registrations are honoured.

surface.name: is_external
surface.intent: Whether a delivery leaves the deployment, i.e. whether the SSRF guard and the external-delivery rules apply.

surface.name: is_signed
surface.intent: Whether subscriptions of a delivery type carry an HMAC signing secret — decides whether a secret is minted and shown once.

surface.name: register_delivery_type
surface.intent: Add, replace or remove (None) a delivery type at runtime, over the built-ins and STAPEL_WEBHOOKS['DELIVERY_TYPES'] — the code twin of the settings seam for a host that registers after boot.

surface.name: reset_delivery_types
surface.intent: Tests only: drop runtime delivery-type overrides so one test's registration does not leak into the next.

surface.name: resolve_delivery
surface.intent: The live spec for one delivery type, raising UnknownDeliveryType for a removed or unknown one — the lookup every planner and validator goes through.

surface.name: validate_target
surface.intent: Refuse a subscription target its delivery type cannot use (required keys, any-of keys, the type's own target_validator) before a row is written.

requires.reason: comm Action bus with the transactional outbox (what is reacted to), Signals (ws delivery), notifications publish (notification delivery), the SSRF address guard, AppSettings, JWT auth and the error envelope
renders and sends the notification delivery type; without it that type cannot deliver
carries the ws delivery type's frames to connected clients
